sourceEvidence.title: Functional Engineering Project Management (EPM) Frontline Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
* **Requires U.S. Government TS clearance at time of application**
* Bachelors Degree and 8 years of applicable technical experience, or a Masters Degree plus 6 years of applicable experience, with a minimum of 1 year of engineering leadership experience
* 2 years of demonstrated success in Project Management roles such as CAM, IPT Lead, Program Manager, or Engineering Program Manager/Lead to include earned value management (EVM)
* Experience with at least one phase of the lifecycle of space system development, build, and operations
